_doc: QUIET-DEFAULT-BUILD-1 baseline for scripts/check-default-build-quiet.py. This is ATTRIBUTED DEBT, not an approved list -- but unlike the 83-tag seed it replaces, every entry now carries a `keep` reason naming the harness code that parses it. History: VERIFY-INTEGRITY-3 measured 83 tags printing in a default build (nine repeating every 600 frames forever, four announcing switched-OFF features). QUIET-DEFAULT-BUILD-1 gated 70 of them behind MC2_DIAG_VERBOSE, taking a measured default-env mc2_10 run from 79 distinct tags / 439 diagnostic lines to 9 tags / 44 lines. The 9 that remain are load-bearing for verification itself: silencing them would blind the smoke harness, which is a worse failure than being noisy. Changing that is a harness-contract change and belongs to its own slice. The ratchet only ever tightens: gating a tag and removing it here is always correct; adding one requires a keep reason.

BUILD_FINGERPRINT v1.reason: scripts/smoke_lib/fingerprint.py parses this to prove the smoked exe matches the worktree HEAD. Silencing it disables DEPLOY_FINGERPRINT attribution -- the single strongest anti-'unverifiable work' control in the harness.

CONFIG v1.reason: Gates/gate.cpp dumpConfig: ONE summary line per start (set/nondefault/unregistered/badvalue counts) plus a line per env-set gate and each warning. The smoke runner forces MC2_CONFIG_STRICT=1 and reads these lines to prove which configuration was measured; per-row lines for unset gates only print under MC2_CONFIG_DUMP=all.

HDRI_SKY v1.reason: FAIL-LOUD by design (GameOS/gameos/gos_hdri.cpp): EXR load/decode, GL texture creation and GL upload failures disable the HDRI sky; gosPostProcess::setSkyNumber leaves the sky black on load failure. Stock-profile smoke logs expose missing data/hdr EXRs at startup and mission load. These failures must remain visible; successful loads, sidecar fallback and sun-scan diagnostics are already MC2_DIAGFE-gated.

INSTR v1.reason: scripts/whatran.py and smoke_lib/gates.py parse the 'enabled:' banner to record which gates were armed for a run. smoke_lib/gates.py reports '[INSTR v1] banner absent' as a failure.

PERF v1.reason: scripts/smoke_lib/logparse.py parses avg_fps/p50_ms/p99_ms (oracle_report.py and smoke_with_screenshots.py, the other readers, were retired 2026-10-09 and 2026-10-12). This is the perf regression signal.

QUADSETUP_SKIP v1.reason: Human-readable smoke oracle (fullyArmed=/skip=). Its parser smoke_lib/oracleparse.py was retired 2026-10-11 (owner ruling 2026-10-09 #11) with no replacement; the line stays until a gate owns it.

RENDER_SNAPSHOT v3.reason: The static-prop snapshot oracle (count_mismatch/pkt_mismatch, want 0). Its parser smoke_lib/oracleparse.py was retired 2026-10-11 with no replacement; the line stays until a gate owns it.

SMOKE v1.reason: scripts/run_smoke.py, smoke_lib/runner.py and run_editor_playtest_smoke.py key their pass/fail verdict off the [SMOKE v1] line; run_editor_playtest_smoke.py requires it explicitly. This IS the harness's result channel.

TERRAIN_SHORELINE v1.reason: FAIL-LOUD by design (DEPLOY-CURRENT-1, mclib/terrain.cpp): only the sidecar NOT FOUND / load-failure lines print by default; LOADED is MC2_DIAGF. Prints once per mission load on maps without a cooked shoreline mask.

TGL_POOL v1.reason: scripts/smoke_lib/logparse.py counts pool_nulls from lines containing 'nulls='.

TIMING v1.reason: scripts/smoke_lib/logparse.py TIMING_RE parses event=/elapsed_ms= for load-phase timing.

VIDEO v1.reason: Regression floor of the video surface (owner ruling 2026-10-13, M1): one line per movie request, skip or play (campaign-start and won-mission pre-videos in code/missionbegin.cpp / logistics.cpp / logistics_begin.cpp, in-mission videos in controlgui_chat.cpp as event=play_requested), a few lines per session. Parsed by scripts/smoke_lib/logparse.py PRESENCE_RULES (an absence rule: tier1/tier2 mc2_10 must print an event=play_requested line or the row is red, bucket video_floor_missing; scripts/smoke_lib/gates.py applies it). The campaign-start pre_video line is not yet enforced: it needs a campaign-boot run, so until one exists the proof procedure greps it.

WATER_SHORE_EDGE v1.reason: FAIL-LOUD by design (mclib/terrain.cpp): default shore mode 2 silently degrades to mask mode when visual_height_4x.r32 is missing from the install; NOT FOUND/size/read failures print once per mission load. LOADED is MC2_DIAGF (2026-10-07).

VRAM v1.reason: scripts/smoke_lib/vram.py parses the load_end / run_end GPU-memory lines into the smoke report and the perf baseline. GameOS/gameos/gpu_memory_report.cpp prints them only when the smoke harness or MC2_DIAG_VERBOSE asked for diagnostics (log() returns early otherwise), so a player's console stays quiet; this check grades a smoke log, which is why it sees the tag.

VRAM_ADAPTER v1.reason: Printed once before the first [VRAM v1] line, under the same smoke / MC2_DIAG_VERBOSE guard, and says which rule (luid or most_dedicated) picked the DXGI adapter the VRAM numbers come from; a reader of a VRAM figure on a two-GPU host needs it. No parser consumes it.
